0022600193.text: The Warriors (6-3, 2nd in the Pacific, 1 game back, 7th in the West) are riding a six-game winning streak and are 4-1 at home, while the Magic (2-6, 5th in the Southeast, 12th in the East) have lost three straight and are 0-4 at home. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Draymond Green (elbow inflammation), Gary Payton II (calf), and Gui Santos (knee) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain). The teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the Warriors' most recent meeting was a 120-97 win in San Francisco on December 22, 2025, with no games yet between them in 2026-27.
